26: /**
27:  * {@link BulkScorer} that is used for pure disjunctions and disjunctions that have low values of
28:  * {@link BooleanQuery.Builder#setMinimumNumberShouldMatch(int)} and dense clauses. This scorer
29:  * scores documents by batches of 4,096 docs.
30:  */
31: final class BooleanScorer extends BulkScorer {
32: 
33:   static final int SHIFT = 12;
34:   static final int SIZE = 1 << SHIFT;
35:   static final int MASK = SIZE - 1;
36: 
37:   static class Bucket {
38:     double score;
39:     int freq;
40:   }
41: 
42:   // One bucket per doc ID in the window, non-null if scores are needed or if frequencies need to be
43:   // counted
44:   final Bucket[] buckets;
45:   final FixedBitSet matching = new FixedBitSet(SIZE);
46: 
47:   final DisiWrapper[] leads;
48:   final PriorityQueue<DisiWrapper> head;
49:   final PriorityQueue<DisiWrapper> tail;
50:   final SimpleScorable score = new SimpleScorable();
51:   final int minShouldMatch;
52:   final long cost;
53:   final boolean needsScores;
54:   private final DocAndFloatFeatureBuffer docAndScoreBuffer = new DocAndFloatFeatureBuffer();
55: 
56:   BooleanScorer(Collection<Scorer> scorers, int minShouldMatch, boolean needsScores) {
57:     if (minShouldMatch < 1 || minShouldMatch > scorers.size()) {
58:       throw new IllegalArgumentException(
59:           "minShouldMatch should be within 1..num_scorers. Got " + minShouldMatch);
60:     }
61:     if (scorers.size() <= 1) {
62:       throw new IllegalArgumentException(
63:           "This scorer can only be used with two scorers or more, got " + scorers.size());
64:     }
65:     if (needsScores || minShouldMatch > 1) {
66:       buckets = new Bucket[SIZE];
67:       for (int i = 0; i < buckets.length; i++) {
68:         buckets[i] = new Bucket();
69:       }
70:     } else {
71:       buckets = null;
72:     }
73:     this.leads = new DisiWrapper[scorers.size()];
74:     this.head =
75:         PriorityQueue.usingLessThan(scorers.size() - minShouldMatch + 1, (a, b) -> a.doc < b.doc);
76:     this.tail = PriorityQueue.usingLessThan(minShouldMatch - 1, (a, b) -> a.cost < b.cost);
77:     this.minShouldMatch = minShouldMatch;
78:     this.needsScores = needsScores;
79:     LongArrayList costs = new LongArrayList(scorers.size());
80:     for (Scorer scorer : scorers) {
81:       DisiWrapper w = new DisiWrapper(scorer, false);
82:       costs.add(w.cost);
83:       final DisiWrapper evicted = tail.insertWithOverflow(w);
84:       if (evicted != null) {
85:         head.add(evicted);
86:       }
87:     }
88:     this.cost = ScorerUtil.costWithMinShouldMatch(costs.stream(), costs.size(), minShouldMatch);
89:   }

92:   public long cost() {

96:   private void scoreWindowIntoBitSetAndReplay(
97:       LeafCollector collector,
98:       Bits acceptDocs,
99:       int base,
100:       int min,
101:       int max,
102:       DisiWrapper[] scorers,
103:       int numScorers)
104:       throws IOException {
105:     for (int i = 0; i < numScorers; ++i) {
106:       final DisiWrapper w = scorers[i];
107:       assert w.doc < max;
108: 
109:       DocIdSetIterator it = w.iterator;
110:       if (w.doc < min) {
111:         it.advance(min);
112:       }
113:       if (buckets == null) { // means minShouldMatch=1 and scores are not needed
114:         // This doesn't apply live docs, so we'll need to apply them later
115:         it.intoBitSet(max, matching, base);
116:       } else if (needsScores) {
117:         for (w.scorer.nextDocsAndScores(max, acceptDocs, docAndScoreBuffer);
118:             docAndScoreBuffer.size > 0;
119:             w.scorer.nextDocsAndScores(max, acceptDocs, docAndScoreBuffer)) {
120:           for (int index = 0; index < docAndScoreBuffer.size; ++index) {
121:             final int doc = docAndScoreBuffer.docs[index];
122:             final float score = docAndScoreBuffer.features[index];
123:             final int d = doc & MASK;
124:             matching.set(d);
125:             final Bucket bucket = buckets[d];
126:             bucket.freq++;
127:             bucket.score += score;
128:           }
129:         }
130:       } else {
131:         // Scores are not needed but we need to keep track of freqs to know which hits match
132:         assert minShouldMatch > 1;
133:         for (int doc = it.docID(); doc < max; doc = it.nextDoc()) {
134:           if (acceptDocs == null || acceptDocs.get(doc)) {
135:             final int d = doc & MASK;
136:             matching.set(d);
137:             final Bucket bucket = buckets[d];
138:             bucket.freq++;
139:           }
140:         }
141:       }
142: 
143:       w.doc = it.docID();
144:     }
145: 
146:     if (buckets == null) {
147:       if (acceptDocs != null) {
148:         // In this case, live docs have not been applied yet.
149:         acceptDocs.applyMask(matching, base);
150:       }
151:       collector.collect(new BitSetDocIdStream(matching, base));
152:     } else {
153:       FixedBitSet matching = BooleanScorer.this.matching;
154:       Bucket[] buckets = BooleanScorer.this.buckets;
155:       long[] bitArray = matching.getBits();
156:       for (int idx = 0; idx < bitArray.length; idx++) {
157:         long bits = bitArray[idx];
158:         while (bits != 0L) {
159:           int ntz = Long.numberOfTrailingZeros(bits);
160:           final int indexInWindow = (idx << 6) | ntz;
161:           final Bucket bucket = buckets[indexInWindow];
162:           if (bucket.freq >= minShouldMatch) {
163:             score.score = (float) bucket.score;
164:             collector.collect(base | indexInWindow);
165:           }
166:           bucket.freq = 0;
167:           bucket.score = 0;
168:           bits ^= 1L << ntz;
169:         }
170:       }
171:     }

173:     matching.clear();

176:   private DisiWrapper advance(int min) throws IOException {
177:     assert tail.size() == minShouldMatch - 1;
178:     final PriorityQueue<DisiWrapper> head = this.head;
179:     final PriorityQueue<DisiWrapper> tail = this.tail;
180:     DisiWrapper headTop = head.top();
181:     DisiWrapper tailTop = tail.top();
182:     while (headTop.doc < min) {
183:       if (tailTop == null || headTop.cost <= tailTop.cost) {
184:         headTop.doc = headTop.iterator.advance(min);
185:         headTop = head.updateTop();
186:       } else {
187:         // swap the top of head and tail
188:         final DisiWrapper previousHeadTop = headTop;
189:         tailTop.doc = tailTop.iterator.advance(min);
190:         headTop = head.updateTop(tailTop);
191:         tailTop = tail.updateTop(previousHeadTop);
192:       }
193:     }
194:     return headTop;
195:   }

197:   private void scoreWindowMultipleScorers(
198:       LeafCollector collector,
199:       Bits acceptDocs,
200:       int windowBase,
201:       int windowMin,
202:       int windowMax,
203:       int maxFreq)
204:       throws IOException {
205:     while (maxFreq < minShouldMatch && maxFreq + tail.size() >= minShouldMatch) {
206:       // a match is still possible
207:       final DisiWrapper candidate = tail.pop();
208:       if (candidate.doc < windowMin) {
209:         candidate.doc = candidate.iterator.advance(windowMin);
210:       }
211:       if (candidate.doc < windowMax) {
212:         leads[maxFreq++] = candidate;
213:       } else {
214:         head.add(candidate);
215:       }
216:     }
217: 
218:     if (maxFreq >= minShouldMatch) {
219:       // There might be matches in other scorers from the tail too
220:       for (DisiWrapper disiWrapper : tail) {
221:         leads[maxFreq++] = disiWrapper;
222:       }
223:       tail.clear();
224: 
225:       scoreWindowIntoBitSetAndReplay(
226:           collector, acceptDocs, windowBase, windowMin, windowMax, leads, maxFreq);
227:     }
228: 
229:     // Push back scorers into head and tail
230:     for (int i = 0; i < maxFreq; ++i) {
231:       final DisiWrapper evicted = head.insertWithOverflow(leads[i]);
232:       if (evicted != null) {
233:         tail.add(evicted);
234:       }
235:     }
236:   }

19: import java.io.IOException;
20: import java.util.Arrays;
21: import java.util.Collection;
22: import java.util.Comparator;
23: import org.apache.lucene.util.ArrayUtil;
24: import org.apache.lucene.util.FixedBitSet;
25: 
26: /**
27:  * A {@link DocIdSetIterator} which is a disjunction of the approximations of the provided
28:  * iterators.
29:  *
30:  * @lucene.internal
31:  */
32: public final class DisjunctionDISIApproximation extends AbstractDocIdSetIterator {
33: 
34:   public static DisjunctionDISIApproximation of(
35:       Collection<? extends DisiWrapper> subIterators, long leadCost) {
36: 
37:     return new DisjunctionDISIApproximation(subIterators, leadCost);
38:   }
39: 
40:   // Heap of iterators that lead iteration.
41:   private final DisiPriorityQueue leadIterators;
42:   // List of iterators that will likely advance on every call to nextDoc() / advance()
43:   private final DisiWrapper[] otherIterators;
44:   private final long cost;
45:   private DisiWrapper leadTop;
46:   private int minOtherDoc;
47: 
48:   public DisjunctionDISIApproximation(
49:       Collection<? extends DisiWrapper> subIterators, long leadCost) {
50:     // Using a heap to store disjunctive clauses is great for exhaustive evaluation, when a single
51:     // clause needs to move through the heap on every iteration on average. However, when
52:     // intersecting with a selective filter, it is possible that all clauses need advancing, which
53:     // makes the reordering cost scale in O(N * log(N)) per advance() call when checking clauses
54:     // linearly would scale in O(N).
55:     // To protect against this reordering overhead, we try to have 1.5 clauses or less that advance
56:     // on every advance() call by only putting clauses into the heap as long as Σ min(1, cost /
57:     // leadCost) <= 1.5, or Σ min(leadCost, cost) <= 1.5 * leadCost. Other clauses are checked
58:     // linearly.
59: 
60:     DisiWrapper[] wrappers = subIterators.toArray(DisiWrapper[]::new);
61:     // Sort by descending cost.
62:     Arrays.sort(wrappers, Comparator.<DisiWrapper>comparingLong(w -> w.cost).reversed());
63: 
64:     long reorderThreshold = leadCost + (leadCost >> 1);
65:     if (reorderThreshold < 0) { // overflow
66:       reorderThreshold = Long.MAX_VALUE;
67:     }
68: 
69:     long cost = 0; // track total cost
70:     // Split `wrappers` into those that will remain out of the PQ, and those that will go in
71:     // (PQ entries at the end). `lastIdx` is the last index of the wrappers that will remain out.
72:     long reorderCost = 0;
73:     int lastIdx = wrappers.length - 1;
74:     for (; lastIdx >= 0; lastIdx--) {
75:       long lastCost = wrappers[lastIdx].cost;
76:       long inc = Math.min(lastCost, leadCost);
77:       if (reorderCost + inc < 0 || reorderCost + inc > reorderThreshold) {
78:         break;
79:       }
80:       reorderCost += inc;
81:       cost += lastCost;
82:     }
83: 
84:     // Make leadIterators not empty. This helps save conditionals in the implementation which are
85:     // rarely tested.
86:     if (lastIdx == wrappers.length - 1) {
87:       cost += wrappers[lastIdx].cost;
88:       lastIdx--;
89:     }
90: 
91:     // Build the PQ:
92:     assert lastIdx >= -1 && lastIdx < wrappers.length - 1;
93:     int pqLen = wrappers.length - lastIdx - 1;
94:     leadIterators = DisiPriorityQueue.ofMaxSize(pqLen);
95:     leadIterators.addAll(wrappers, lastIdx + 1, pqLen);
96: 
97:     // Build the non-PQ list:
98:     otherIterators = ArrayUtil.copyOfSubArray(wrappers, 0, lastIdx + 1);
99:     minOtherDoc = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
100:     for (DisiWrapper w : otherIterators) {
101:       cost += w.cost;
102:       minOtherDoc = Math.min(minOtherDoc, w.doc);
103:     }
104: 
105:     this.cost = cost;
106:     leadTop = leadIterators.top();
107:   }
108: 
109:   @Override
110:   public long cost() {
111:     return cost;
112:   }
113: 
114:   @Override
115:   public int nextDoc() throws IOException {
116:     if (leadTop.doc < minOtherDoc) {
117:       int curDoc = leadTop.doc;
118:       do {
119:         leadTop.doc = leadTop.approximation.nextDoc();
120:         leadTop = leadIterators.updateTop();
121:       } while (leadTop.doc == curDoc);
122:       return doc = Math.min(leadTop.doc, minOtherDoc);
123:     } else {
124:       return advance(minOtherDoc + 1);
125:     }
126:   }
127: 
128:   @Override
129:   public int advance(int target) throws IOException {
130:     while (leadTop.doc < target) {
131:       leadTop.doc = leadTop.approximation.advance(target);
132:       leadTop = leadIterators.updateTop();
133:     }
134: 
135:     minOtherDoc = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
136:     for (DisiWrapper w : otherIterators) {
137:       if (w.doc < target) {
138:         w.doc = w.approximation.advance(target);
139:       }
140:       minOtherDoc = Math.min(minOtherDoc, w.doc);
141:     }
142: 
143:     return doc = Math.min(leadTop.doc, minOtherDoc);
144:   }
145: 
146:   @Override
147:   public void intoBitSet(int upTo, FixedBitSet bitSet, int offset) throws IOException {
148:     while (leadTop.doc < upTo) {
149:       leadTop.approximation.intoBitSet(upTo, bitSet, offset);
150:       leadTop.doc = leadTop.approximation.docID();
151:       leadTop = leadIterators.updateTop();
152:     }
153: 
154:     minOtherDoc = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
155:     for (DisiWrapper w : otherIterators) {
156:       w.approximation.intoBitSet(upTo, bitSet, offset);
157:       w.doc = w.approximation.docID();
158:       minOtherDoc = Math.min(minOtherDoc, w.doc);
159:     }
160: 
161:     doc = Math.min(leadTop.doc, minOtherDoc);
162:   }
163: 
164:   /** Return the linked list of iterators positioned on the current doc. */
165:   public DisiWrapper topList() {
166:     if (leadTop.doc < minOtherDoc) {
167:       return leadIterators.topList();
168:     } else {
169:       return computeTopList();
170:     }
171:   }
172: 
173:   private DisiWrapper computeTopList() {
174:     assert leadTop.doc >= minOtherDoc;
175:     DisiWrapper topList = null;
176:     if (leadTop.doc == minOtherDoc) {
177:       topList = leadIterators.topList();
178:     }
179:     for (DisiWrapper w : otherIterators) {
180:       if (w.doc == minOtherDoc) {
181:         w.next = topList;
182:         topList = w;
183:       }
184:     }
185:     return topList;
186:   }
187: 
188:   @Override
189:   public int docIDRunEnd() throws IOException {
190:     // We're only looking at the "top" clauses. In theory, we may be able to find longer runs if
191:     // other clauses have overlapping runs with the runs of the top clauses, but does it actually
192:     // happen in practice and would it buy much?
193:     int maxDocIDRunEnd = super.docIDRunEnd();
194:     for (DisiWrapper w = topList(); w != null; w = w.next) {
195:       maxDocIDRunEnd = Math.max(maxDocIDRunEnd, w.approximation.docIDRunEnd());
196:     }
197:     return maxDocIDRunEnd;
198:   }
